review.reviewer: Codex implementation owner, self-review; not independent approval
review.decision: Separate authorized pane-screen reading from historical conversation input restrictions
review.notes: User reports working Live row cannot expand while association is pending. Exact main9a534a9c ChatView merges readOnlyHistory into readOnly, then hides the Live disclosure; parents already read the separately authorized current pane. Keep conversation sends, uploads, input keys, exact-session binding and explicit desktop/native readOnly fences unchanged. Allow read-only current-pane preview with a visible pane-source/association-pending caption, never claiming the current pane is the saved conversation. Scope parent captures to the exact client object and pane so switching server/token/pane cannot display a previous capture before the new read settles; preserve existing cancellation/late-response guards. Browser already permits this read and receives the same source caption. No new API, polling loop, live session input, restore, deployment, TCC or installation. Existing valid tests stay byte-for-byte unchanged; new files carry only these cases. MainPR1853 CI continues independently, no reuse of its pass as proof of this change. Browser resize follow-up review after hosted CI surfaced the obsolete 14-row assertion. Both viewport variants compare the full 20-row current-pane capture exactly and retain the caption, input fence, disclosure, and page checks. WLV-002 covers the new 2,000-row bound. Mobile scrollback follow-up: allow earlier rows from the authorized capture even at the default height. Clearing that capture must immediately retire any held frame.

cases.description: Historical Chat can disclose its authorized current pane without gaining input authority
cases.setup: Mounted actual ChatView/LiveProgress with readOnlyHistory, a real synthetic pane ID and bounded synthetic ANSI output; English/Chinese, explicit readOnly, native and no-pane variants.
cases.action: Open, inspect source caption and bounded output, close; refresh and switch conversation scope; inject output into terminal-unavailable variants.
cases.expected: Pending historical Chat shows a real disclosure and its current-pane caption; raw output mounts only after expansion and uses a 220-point default viewport with up to 1,000 accessible rows; clearing the current pane capture discards the held history. No terminal output/disclosure for explicit desktop readOnly, native or missing pane. Existing input/read-only guidance and scope reset/retention semantics remain.

cases.description: Detail and HQ pane captures do not cross client or pane identities
cases.setup: Actual mounted Detail/HQ with controlled deferred pane responses and read-only historical transcripts, isolated context mocks and send spies.
cases.action: Read A, switch client (including same URL/new client) or pane before B resolves, settle late A, then settle B; inspect Live data and try original Chat send callback.
cases.expected: Old capture is absent immediately in the new Live scope; late A cannot replace B. Current B capture appears only after its read settles. Historical Chat send/keys/uploads remain disabled and no send is made. No additional poller is introduced.

cases.description: Browser current-pane Live preview labels pending history and keeps input fenced
cases.setup: Existing isolated production browser fixture at390dark and1440light, working pane with observed historical conversation,20 synthetic screen lines and explicit readonly transcript state.
cases.action: Open Chat, expand Live, compare the current capture and source caption, then collapse; verify no send and pending conversation input remains unavailable.
cases.expected: Live displays exactly the 20 captured rows from the current pane and identifies the pending association. Closing hides output. No send or authority promotion and no page/console errors.
